levels.name: Two Friends
levels.notes: Independent clears. Slide each down; bottom edge brakes on gates. Low collision stress.

levels.name: Collision Order
levels.notes: CEO/Bench bar: order matters. A sliding down hits B, stops at (2,2). B must vacate first (left/right), then both route to corner gates. Walls beside gates force approach along the bottom row — edge does not sit behind gate from above (wall cells flank gates); slide onto gate from the side along y=4 toward edge... Actually gate at (0,4): approach from right along bottom — sliding left from (2,4) stops at edge on (0,4). Good.
levels.antiSkirt: A cannot pass through B. Skipping B-first leaves A stuck mid-column and burns N.

levels.name: Wrong Order Soft-Lock
levels.notes: Orange wants gate at top-right; gray wants bottom-left. Shared corridors + mismatch-as-solid means the obvious first slide soft-blocks the other within N=8. Solve gray's path first (or the documented order), then orange. Edge brakes: orange slides right along y=0 onto o; gray slides down/left onto g.
levels.antiSkirt: Parking orange on gray's only approach turns gray gate approach into a dead end under N=8.
